Root Scope: Japan organizations.
CNA Scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities for OTRS and ((OTRS)) Community Edition and modules only.
SolarWinds products only.
Third-party products it researches.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
StrongDM issues only.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
All Network Optix products, including https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness and https://www.networkoptix.com/powered-by-nx.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
Supported Secomea products only.
Ericsson issues only.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Gen Digital products and websites.
All current products/software/apps made by Logitech, Ultimate Ears, Jaybird, Streamlabs, Logitech G, Logicool, Blue, and Astro Gaming.
Bosch products only.
Jaspersoft products and services only.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
ABB issues only.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All HYPR products only.
Roche’s medical technology products.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Zyxel products issues only.
All products and services developed and operated by FPT Software, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by FPT Software that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.

Products and technologies branded by Bull and its subsidiaries, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software and hardware discovered by Bull and its subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
SailPoint issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Adobe issues only.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Pegasystems products only.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
Juniper issues only.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
